## Session Overview

This session replaces the prior-year Portfolio I workshop (portfolio development moves to November). A panel of mentor-practitioners will discuss how they built their professional identity and practice.

## When we Meet

Held over **Zoom** (link posted in Canvas).

### Learn

Panel discussion with our mentor-practitioners. The point isn't to pick one of them to become — it's to see the range of professional paths and the trade-offs each panelist has made.

### Reflect

Q&A with the panel. Listen for the trade-offs each panelist has made, not just their job titles. Leave with one thing you want to test in your own professional identity.

## Before we Meet

- Watch our **October pre-session video** (professional identity before the panel).

- Prepare two questions for the panelists — ones you genuinely can't answer yourself.

## After we Meet

- Mentee-initiate the mid-fall check-in with your mentor (schedule it now, so it happens this month).

- Accomplish your October goal.

**Course milestone:** Professional Development Plan (Oct).

**Mentoring milestone:** October mentor panel (mentors opt in via the mentor survey).
